description: This file defines the DataService class, which manages data-related operations for a modem simulator, including handling data calls, PDP contexts, and physical channel configurations.

classes.name: DataService
classes.description: A class that provides data service functionalities for a modem simulator, including handling data calls, PDP contexts, and physical channel configurations.

methods.name: HandleActivateDataCall
methods.description: Handles activation of a data call for a client.

methods.name: HandleQueryDataCallList
methods.description: Handles query requests for the list of data calls.

methods.name: HandleQueryPDPContextList
methods.description: Handles query requests for the list of PDP contexts.

methods.name: HandleEnterDataState
methods.description: Handles commands to enter data state.

methods.name: HandleReadDynamicParam
methods.description: Handles requests to read dynamic parameters.

methods.name: onUpdatePhysicalChannelconfigs
methods.description: Updates physical channel configurations based on modem technology, frequency, and downlink bandwidth.
